name: ConnectedYou
description: Travel eSIM store selling data plans for multiple countries, bought at home and activated on arrival. Its own affiliate partner page publishes a 20% starting commission with monthly payouts, states there is no earning limit, and publishes a direct support email for affiliates (esim@connectedyou.io).

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page: 'You earn 20% or more for every customer you bring', 'When someone purchases an eSIM using your link or coupon, you earn 20% commission. Get monthly payouts', and in its FAQ: 'Earn 20% commission or more on all sales via your affiliate link. There's no earning limit, and payments are made monthly.' The fetched page explicitly states there is no earning limit, so commission_cap is UNCAPPED.

The same page recruits tech influencers, travel bloggers, content creators, eCommerce owners and hospitality partners, offers a free affiliate account with a unique referral link or QR code and real-time dashboard tracking, repeats 'there's no commission limit' in its maximisation answer, and publishes the affiliate support email esim@connectedyou.io. No creator counts are published, so creator_saturation stays unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: eSIM data is a core travel-creator staple - arrival, connectivity and travel-hack content for every destination audience.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page is creator-first: it names influencers, travel bloggers and content creators, and supplies referral links, QR codes for offline marketing and a real-time dashboard.
reasons.compensation: 20% starting commission with monthly payouts, published on the brand's own page, and the page explicitly states there is no earning limit - verified UNCAPPED.
reasons.contact_access: A direct affiliate support email (esim@connectedyou.io) is published on the program page itself - unusually accessible for a program this size.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free affiliate account from the brand's own page; sign-up is a simple partner registration.
reasons.credibility: A real operating eSIM storefront with a detailed program page, but a smaller, younger brand than the major travel names in the directory.

name: Cellesim
description: Travel eSIM brand covering 190+ countries in 24 languages. Its own partner page pays 20% cash (not store credit) on every attributed sale with a 30-day first-touch cookie, a $50 payout threshold and NET-30 payment cycles via PayPal, Wise or bank transfer - and its FAQ states there is no cap on how much a partner can earn.

evidence.summary: The brand's own partner page: 'earn 20% cash on every sale', '20% cash, not credits', a 30-day cookie and a $50 minimum payout on NET-30 cycles. Its FAQ answers 'How much do I earn?' with: 'You earn 20% cash on the order value of every eSIM sale attributed to your link. There is no cap on how much you can earn.' The fetched page explicitly states no cap, so commission_cap is UNCAPPED.

The same page says it is 'Trusted by travel creators, bloggers and newsletters in 190+ countries', that most creators are approved within a couple of days with no traffic minimums, and that audience size does not matter ('we care more about relevance and trust'). That is eligibility evidence, not a creator count, so creator_saturation stays unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: eSIMs for 190+ countries fit any travel creator's toolkit - destination guides, packing lists and arrival tips.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The partner page is built for creators: personal short links, deep links to country pages, a live dashboard and explicit 'no big audience needed' language.
reasons.compensation: 20% cash on every sale with a 30-day cookie, published on the brand's own page, and the FAQ explicitly states there is no cap on earnings - verified UNCAPPED.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own partner page; no direct partnerships email is published on it.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application with no traffic minimums and a stated couple-of-days approval.
reasons.credibility: A real, operating eSIM storefront with unusually transparent payout terms, but a young brand with a short track record.

name: Kaya Movement
description: Sustainable activewear and movement-apparel brand running a hands-on ambassador program through UpPromote. Its own ambassadors page publishes a 20% commission on every sale made through an ambassador's link or coupon, a 90-day link window, free merchandise to create with, and twice-monthly payouts - with a published contact email for questions.

evidence.summary: The brand's own ambassadors page: 'You get free merchandise, 20% commission for every sale made through your referral link and coupon and 30% lifetime discount to shop in our store', 'An Ambassador link is limited to 90 Calendar Days per customer', and 'Get paid on 14th & 28th of every month via Paypal or Bank Transfer', tracked on an UpPromote dashboard (af.uppromote.com). No cap statement appears on the page, so commission_cap stays unknown.

The same page sets the creator mechanics: ambassadors are chosen for brand fit, must create a minimum of 2 images and a 15-second reel with the products within 2 weeks, gift followers 15% off, and join on a 6-month trial. It publishes the contact email contact@kayamovement.com for program questions. No creator counts are published, so creator_saturation stays unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: Sustainable activewear with a strong visual identity is prime fitness and yoga UGC - movement demos, outfit content and wellness routines.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A true creator program, not a bare affiliate link: free merchandise to film with, defined content deliverables, a personalised coupon, a live dashboard and marketing tools library.
reasons.compensation: 20% on every sale through link or coupon with a 90-day window and twice-monthly payouts, published on the brand's own page; no cap statement was found, so the cap is honestly unknown.
reasons.contact_access: The program page publishes a direct email (contact@kayamovement.com) for ambassador questions.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Selective rather than open: ambassadors are 'specially chosen' for brand fit and start on a 6-month trial, which limits availability.
reasons.credibility: A real, operating DTC activewear brand with detailed published program terms, but small and niche.
